# Interview bank — AGENTS.md

Ask only what the repo cannot answer — the analysis (step 1) answers
the rest. The five discriminating questions:

1. Which commands exactly (build, targeted test, lint), and which must
   NEVER be run (watch, deploy)? (Feeds the stack sections; every
   command in the file must have been run or confirmed.)
2. What did the agent get wrong recently? (Each observed failure
   becomes the line that would have prevented it.)
3. Which conventions diverge from the ecosystem defaults? (Only the
   divergences are documented — the model already knows the standards.)
4. What is already enforced mechanically — linter, CI, hooks? (It is
   excluded from the file.)
5. Monorepo? Which existing configs (CLAUDE.md, `.cursor/rules/`,
   `.cursorrules`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) must be imported?
   (Feeds the inventory and the import.)

Present each pre-drafted section with its evidence and ask the user to
confirm or correct it — a confirmation is cheaper than a dictation,
and a wrong line is worse than a missing one.
